caption: The drawing depicts a single round shallow dish with a decorative handle attached to its upper rim, rendered in grayscale pencil on a light cream-colored background. The bowl is shown from a top-down perspective, with detailed shading to indicate depth and curvature. The handle is ornate, featuring scrollwork and a circular opening at the top, and is attached to the bowl's upper edge. The drawing is centered within a rectangular border. In the bottom right corner, there is a small, separate sketch depicting a side view of the bowl with linear measurements, also done in pencil. There is no text present except for the small notations in the side-view diagram. The entire composition is monochrome, with various shades of gray used to create depth, detail, and shadow.
title: Pewter Porringer
